verdict.rationale: Alloy is an API-first SaaS, so issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials is a fair question for it. The pack contains no evidence of credential scoping, per-key permissions, or agent-specific keys. The only key-related detail is that the same keys work in both Sandbox and Production modes, which is not scoping. SAML SSO/SCIM and webhook shared-secret signing are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
